title: Qiagen QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit Protocol
author: QIAgen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d7f9jm

steps.title: Pellet bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1–5 mL overnight bacterial culture at > 6,800 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in Buffer P1
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 250 µL Buffer P1 (ensure RNase A is added). If LyseBlue reagent is present, shake the buffer bottle vigorously to dissolve particles, then vortex or pipette up and down until no cell clumps remain.

steps.title: Add Buffer P2 and lyse
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Buffer P2 and mix gently by inverting the tube 4–6 times (do not vortex). Continue inverting until the solution becomes viscous, slightly clear, and homogeneously colored (blue if LyseBlue was used). Keep the lysis reaction ≤ 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Buffer N3 and precipitate
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer N3 and mix immediately and thoroughly by inverting 4–6 times (up to 10 inversions for cultures ≥ 5 mL). The solution should become cloudy and, if LyseBlue was used, turn colorless, indicating SDS precipitation.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 10 minutes at 13,000 rpm (~17,900 × g) in a tabletop microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Load supernatant onto column
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant (≈ 850 µL) to a QIAprep spin column by decanting or pipetting.

steps.title: Spin column, discard flow-through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 30–60 seconds, then discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer PB
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL Buffer PB to the column, centrifuge 30–60 seconds, and discard the flow‑through. (Required for endA⁺ or high‑nuclease strains; not needed for XL‑1 Blue or DH5α.)

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Add 0.75 mL Buffer PE, centrifuge 30–60 seconds, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column by final spin
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through and centrifuge the column at full speed for an additional 1 minute to remove residual wash buffer (especially ethanol from Buffer PE).

steps.title: Transfer column to clean tube
steps.instruction: Place the QIAprep spin column into a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Final centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column in the clean tube for 1 minute to complete the protocol.
